A field such as property_hash may be part of some record schemas, not necessarily every record; no hash or layout selected. Corrected design/capture-contract.md, gates orientation, AGENTS and README; marked prior representation review superseded. Actual record fields and property representation remain to be proposed/reviewed. Ownership and failure findings still apply.
